title: Uncertain and Asymmetric Forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2411.05938v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Survey density forecasts are summarized by their second and third moments, read as uncertainty and as the balance of risks. Neither can be read on its own. In the ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters the variance of an individual inflation density rises with the distance of that forecaster's central forecast from the official target, flat below it and rising above, so that raw dispersion mixes belief imprecision with the arithmetic of the level; and a third moment computed over a handful of bins is too noisy to identify directional risk unless it is read together with the location of the density. This paper builds, from the reported bins up, two measures that repair these defects. Normalized Uncertainty divides a density's standard deviation by the one the fitted variance-distance envelope predicts at the observed distance. translated_title: 不确定与非对称的预测
translated_abstract: 调查密度预测通常通过其二阶矩和三阶矩来概括，分别被解读为不确定性和风险平衡，但两者都不能脱离彼此单独解读。在欧洲央行专业预测者调查（ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters）中，个体通胀密度预测的方差随着预测者核心预测与官方目标之间距离的增加而上升——低于目标时保持平稳，高于目标时逐渐上升，因此原始离散度将信念的不精确性与水平值本身的算术效应混杂在一起；同时，基于少数几个区间计算出的三阶矩噪声过大，除非与密度预测的位置信息结合起来解读，否则无法识别方向性风险。本文从报告的区间数据出发，构建了两个能够修复这些缺陷的度量指标：标准化不确定性将某一密度预测的标准差除以拟合的方差-距离包络线在观测距离处所预测的标准差；不对称一致性则仅在报告的不对称符号与密度位置所隐含的方向一致时，才保留方向性风险。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“标准化不确定性”和“不对称一致性”两个新指标，从调查密度预测中剥离预测水平带来的干扰和噪声，从而可靠地度量不确定性与方向性风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two new measures, Normalized Uncertainty and Asymmetry Coherence, which strip out level effects and noise in survey density forecasts to reliably gauge uncertainty and directional risk.
